تستقطعون (form X)
# تَسْتَقْطِعُونَ (tastaqṭiʕūna) /tas.taq.tˤi.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
# تُسْتَقْطَعُونَ (tustaqṭaʕūna) /tus.taq.tˤa.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَقْطَعَ (istaqṭaʕa)
